cases.name: text-only-answer
cases.description: One model call, no tools: the whole run is one step.

cases.name: one-tool-then-answer
cases.description: A tool step, then an answer. Usage is added up once per model call; run-finish carries the total.

cases.name: parallel-tools-complete-out-of-order
cases.description: Results are reported in completion order; the message written back to history keeps call order.

cases.name: unknown-tool-names-the-ones-that-exist
cases.description: A call to a tool that is not there never reaches the driver: the loop answers it, listing the real names.

cases.name: tool-failure-goes-back-to-the-model
cases.description: A failed tool is a result, not a crash: the run goes on and the model sees the failure.

cases.name: step-limit-while-still-working
cases.description: At maxSteps with the model still calling tools, the run says it is cut short (a notice, not prose) and ends tool-calls.

cases.name: confirm-tool-approved
cases.description: A confirm tool asks first. awaiting-user, then user-responded, then the tool runs.

cases.name: confirm-tool-declined
cases.description: A declined confirm tool does not run; the model is told so and the run goes on. A person's no is a result the model reads, not the end of the run, unless the host adds userDeclined (next case).

cases.name: confirm-tool-declined-with-user-declined-stop
cases.description: The same decline with userDeclined in stopWhen: the run ends right after the result, finishReason stop, no second model call.

cases.name: confirm-tool-with-no-way-to-ask
cases.description: A host that cannot ask never runs a confirm tool, and never shows a card.

output.error: "rename" needs the user's approval and this host cannot ask for it.
"rename" needs the user's approval and this host cannot ask for it.

cases.name: confirm-tool-runs-after-the-parallel-ones
cases.description: In one step, ordinary tools run together first; confirm tools run one at a time after, so their results come last.

cases.name: consecutive-failures-stop-the-run
cases.description: Two steps in a row where every tool failed: stop, finishReason stop, no third model call.

cases.name: after-tool-stops-the-run
cases.description: afterTool: the run ends right after that tool succeeds. No further model call.

cases.name: token-budget-stops-the-run
cases.description: tokenBudgetExceeded is checked after the tools of a step, against the running total.

cases.name: model-error-ends-the-run-as-error
cases.description: A failed model call: error (not recoverable), then run-finish error. Steps counts the attempt.

cases.name: cancel-while-tools-run
cases.description: Cancel arrives while a tool is running. The tool settles, then the loop stops before the next step: error cancelled, run-finish cancelled, no step-start.

cases.name: illegal-input-is-refused
cases.description: An input that answers nothing the machine asked for is a driver bug. It is refused, and nothing is emitted.

cases.name: user-declined-from-a-tool-that-asks-for-itself
cases.description: userDeclined also fires on output.cancelled === true, the answer a tool that asks for itself gets back and returns.

cases.name: user-declined-an-interactive-card
cases.description: userDeclined also fires on output.response.cancelled === true, what a declined interactive card (visualize) returns.

cases.name: a-denial-that-is-not-the-persons-does-not-stop-the-run
cases.description: A tool that says denied for its own reasons is not the person saying no: userDeclined does not fire and the run goes on.

cases.name: repaired-flag-reaches-the-tool-call-event
cases.description: A tool-call part the provider layer had to repair says so (repaired: true); the tool-call event repeats it, and the part is written to history as it came.

cases.name: repeat-guard-blocks-an-identical-call
cases.description: With repeatGuard, a second call with the same name and the same input (key order does not matter) is answered at once as denied and never reaches the driver. A different input still runs.

output.error: Repeated call: "lookup" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.
Repeated call: "lookup" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.

cases.name: repeat-guard-within-one-step
cases.description: Two identical calls in one step: the first runs, the second is blocked. Results are written back in call order.

output.error: Repeated call: "lookup" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.
Repeated call: "lookup" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.

cases.name: repeat-guard-blocks-a-repeat-of-a-declined-call
cases.description: A call the person declined counts as made. Repeating it is blocked without showing the card again.

output.error: Repeated call: "rename" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.
Repeated call: "rename" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.

cases.name: identical-calls-run-when-the-guard-is-off
cases.description: Without repeatGuard nothing is compared: an identical call in a later step runs again.

cases.name: checkpoint-while-the-model-is-called
cases.description: A snapshot taken while the model call is outstanding, then a new process resumes from it: the model is asked again for the same step, and no event is repeated.

cases.name: resume-reruns-only-the-calls-with-no-result
cases.description: Two parallel tools; one has reported when the process dies. After resume only the other is run again (same callId, so a tool can use it as an idempotency key). The finished one is not.

cases.name: resume-while-asking-asks-again
cases.description: The process dies while the person is deciding. After resume the approval card is announced again (a new follower needs it) and the machine waits for the answer.

cases.name: resume-after-approval-runs-the-tool-without-asking-again
cases.description: The person already said yes and the tool was running when the process died. After resume the tool is run again (same callId); the person is not asked a second time.

cases.name: resume-keeps-the-failure-streak-and-the-call-history
cases.description: What a stop condition and the repeat guard remember across steps survives a resume: one failed step before the crash, a blocked repeat after it, and the streak reaches two.

output.error: Repeated call: "fetch" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.
Repeated call: "fetch" was already called with the same input in this run. Use that result or change the arguments.

cases.name: checkpoint-and-resume-are-refused-out-of-turn
cases.description: A snapshot with nothing to save, a resume of a state this version does not know, a resume on a machine that has started, and a snapshot after the run ended are all driver bugs: refused, nothing emitted.
